images.prompt: Flat vector mall-signage logo mark, 1990s food-court identity styling. A stylized panda head rendered as a chrome robotic mask with glowing red eye slits, polished machined metal bevels, the panda's black eye patches and ears reinterpreted as lacquered black plates riveted to brushed chrome, centered on a solid lacquer-red background. Beneath the mask sits a compact bold gold sans-serif wordmark on two lines, letters cleanly separated and perfectly legible. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the previous attempt wrongly drew a chrome rounded-rectangle frame with a red margin outside it. Do not draw any frame. There must be absolutely no chrome outline, no rounded rectangle, no inset border line, no plaque, no badge shape, no card, no drop shadow, no vignette and no margin of any kind. Full-bleed square: the flat lacquer-red background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge and runs off all four sides of the image. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: Panda Xpress 9000

Cinematic wide establishing photograph of a mall food court counter at closing time. A long stainless steel steam table under glowing orange heat lamps, sneeze guard smeared with condensation, chrome serving trays stacked at one end, glossy red-and-gold lacquer panels lining the back wall. Above the counter hangs a large blank chrome robotic panda mask sign with glowing red eye slits and no lettering of any kind. A security gate is half lowered at the left edge. Cold overhead fluorescent light mixed with the warm amber glow of the heat lamps, steam drifting through the frame, high sheen on wet steel, polished terrazzo floor reflections. Anamorphic 35mm, deep focus, deadpan hyperreal realism, completely deserted. No text, no logos, no signage lettering, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
